claims.text: The baseline model used is the Jasper architecture, which serves as a good baseline for exploring further improvements.
The Jasper DR 10x5 model was trained using SGD with momentum for 50 epochs, which is a baseline for comparison with other models.
The study evaluated models with different normalization techniques and activation functions, establishing performance baselines for these configurations.
